description: Random pixel dropout plus thick border cut-outs (4–24 px), like after a fast head turn. The net learns to regenerate.

status.comment: A/B, 500 its each from nice-net (runs/nodrop vs runs/drop30, dropout 0.3). Validation of drop30 also had dropout holes (bug, fixed: dropout now only in training rollouts), so compare against each run's own push-pull: nodrop short 0.0769 vs pp 0.0777 (-1%), 96 frames 0.1560 vs 0.1349 (+16% worse); drop30 short 0.0913 vs pp 0.0982 (-7%: it learned to regenerate knocked-out blobs), 96 frames 0.1800 vs 0.1677 (+7% worse). Suggestive, not conclusive. Clean comparison queued: evaluate.py both nets at 96 steps without dropout, after deep24 finishes (memory: one job at a time) -> runs/<r>/eval96.txt.
